mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS exceeds 200.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand strength, which signals improving corporate revenue outlook and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the interaction term's Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 in two consecutive months signals a contraction in real output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative during INDPRO contractions (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the CPIAUCSL above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate, indicates persistent inflationary pressure that may prompt future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY and FEDFUNDS is stable, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized in the most recent quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during GDPC1 slowdowns (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% and a decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 100k signals labor market deterioration, which reduces consumer confidence and corporate hiring, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both UNRATE > 5.0% and PAYEMS < 100.0, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 for three consecutive months, combined with rising unemployment (UNRATE), indicates a supply-side shock with labor market spillovers, which triggers equity market sell-offs and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 100.0 for three consecutive months and UNRATE > 4.8%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative during joint INDPRO and UNRATE deterioration, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
